description: This file defines classes for bit encoding and decoding within a byte buffer, including methods for packing and unpacking bits and bytes, as well as custom formatters for these classes.

classes.name: bit_encoder
classes.description: Class for encoding bits into a byte buffer, with methods to pack bits and bytes, and to align the buffer.

classes.name: bit_decoder
classes.description: Class for decoding bits from a byte buffer, with methods to unpack bits and bytes, and to align the buffer.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Appends a bitmap of specified bits into the byte buffer, left aligned.

methods.name: pack_bytes
methods.description: Appends a range of bytes into the byte buffer.

methods.name: pack_bytes
methods.description: Appends bytes from a byte_buffer_view into the byte buffer.

methods.name: advance_bits
methods.description: Advances the read position by a specified number of bits.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Reads bits from the buffer into a variable.

methods.name: unpack_bytes
methods.description: Reads unaligned bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: unpack_aligned_bytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of aligned bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: align_bytes
methods.description: Skips bits until the start of the next byte.
